ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Create Scheduled Task
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows Task Scheduler to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-ScheduledTaskAction.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-ScheduledTaskTrigger.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-ScheduledTaskPrincipal.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-ScheduledTask.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Register\\-ScheduledTask.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-CimMethod.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ClassName.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*PS\\_ScheduledTask.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-NameSpace.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Root\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\TaskScheduler.*")))
